requirements.says: An unintentional radiator is authorized before it is marketed; a Class B digital device by Supplier's Declaration of Conformity or certification.
A Class B digital device keeps its radiated emissions within the limits of the section.
A device that charges from a line through another device is tested to the conducted limits; one that runs on its battery alone is not.
The instructions of a Class B digital device carry the statement the paragraph gives, in a prominent place.
The cell is of a type proven to meet sub-section 38.3 of the UN Manual of Tests and Criteria.
The maker and each distributor of the cell make its test summary available, with the elements the paragraph lists.
Whoever makes the cell or battery keeps a record that its tests of (a) passed while the design is offered for transport and 1 year after, and shows it to a government's representative on request.
Unless the cell meets paragraph (c), it has a safety vent or is designed so it cannot rupture violently in conditions normal to transport.
The cell or battery is equipped with a means of preventing external short circuits.
Unless the cells meet paragraph (c), a battery of cells, or of strings of cells, in parallel has a means against dangerous reverse current, such as diodes or fuses.
From May 10, 2024, a lithium ion battery carries its Watt-hour rating on the outside of its case.

A package of the equipment meets subpart B of part 173; it is packed against short circuits, damage by shifting and accidental activation; its outer packaging is strong enough unless the equipment protects the cell as well; spare cells are packed by (b)(3); by aircraft each piece of equipment is kept from touching another, and the package holds none of the classes (b)(7) names.
Equipment that contains the cell is packed so as to prevent accidental operation during transport.

A package of equipment whose cells and batteries keep within the Watt-hour limits of (c)(1) may ship under paragraph (c): the battery marked with its Watt-hour rating, packed by (c)(2), the lithium battery mark of (c)(3) on the package, and by aircraft the limits of (c)(4). Cells that meet (c) are outside (a)(4).

A prototype cell shipped for testing, or a run of at most 100 cells or batteries a year, and equipment that contains them, may ship without the tests of (a) only when packed and noted as (e)(1) to (e)(8) say; not by passenger aircraft.

requirements.says: Each line of a connector that leaves the device has a TVS, the TVS nearer the connector than the part it protects, and no via between the connector and the TVS.
On a two-layer board no power or ground trace is longer than 3 times its width.
